Subject: EU-only processing & VPC access for FinTech evaluation

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the platform looks promising. Before we move to procurement, our security team has a couple of non-negotiable requirements for any vendor that will process customer data:

1) EU-only processing: all customer data and any model inference processing must remain in EU data centers (no cross-border processing to the US) and we need a written commitment for data residency.

2) VPC/private endpoint: we require a VPC or private connectivity option (no public internet endpoints) for API traffic, and the ability to control egress rules and audit logs.

Can you confirm if Redwood can provide these commitments (DPA + SCCs) and the technical approach? Also please attach any SOC 2 summary and the DPA you typically sign so our legal team can review.

We are on a tight timeline — procurement wants vendor commitments by end of next week.

Thanks,
Lisa Klein
Procurement Lead
FinTech EU Ltd
[External]

Hi Lisa — great to hear and thanks for the clear requirements. Short answer: yes, we can support EU-only processing and private connectivity, but there are two paths depending on your needs. I summarized below and attached our DPA and a high-level architecture diagram.

Quick summary:
- Hosted (Redwood API) with EU-only routing: we can route requests and store artifacts only in EU regions and sign SCCs; suitable if you accept a hosted contract with an EU data residency clause.
- Private deployment (Redwood Private / VPC): for stricter control we offer a Private deployment in your VPC or a customer-dedicated VPC peered to your network. This supports private endpoints, customer-managed KMS, and full audit logging.

Please see attachments: Redwood_DPA_2026.pdf (DPA + SCCs), EU-residency-arch.png (deployment patterns), SOC2-summary.xlsx (controls mapping).

A few clarifying Qs for procurement/security so we can prepare a final commitment quickly:
- Do you require physical isolation (single-tenant hardware) or logical isolation in EU-only tenancy is sufficient?
- Who will own the KMS keys (Redwood-managed or customer-managed in their KMS/HSM)?
- Do you need data deletion certificates on a per-customer basis or periodic reports?

Looping in Neha (legal) and Vivek (security) to provide formal language on SCCs, DPA counterparty edits, and the VPC connectivity options.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Marissa — I reviewed Lisa's email and the attached DPA. Short answers and recommended language below that legal can provide to procurement:

1) EU-only processing commitment (hosted): we can commit in the DPA that data and processing will occur only in EU jurisdictions identified (e.g., eu-west-1 / eu-central-1) and that Redwood will not transfer customer personal data outside the EU except as required by law. Recommended clause: "Redwood shall process Customer Data solely within the European Economic Area (EEA) or other EU-designated regions, unless Customer provides prior written consent."

2) SCCs: we will execute the EU Commission Standard Contractual Clauses (controller-processor or processor-subprocessor module as appropriate). We'll attach the SCCs as Annex A to the DPA.

3) VPC / Private deployment: we treat this as an enterprise-level offering (Redwood Private). For customers who require private networking and customer-managed KMS we offer:
   - Customer-dedicated VPC peering or PrivateLink with regional endpoints.
   - Option for customer-managed KMS keys (we will not have access to plaintext).
   - Audit logging and SIEM integration (CloudTrail/Syslog exports) with retention settings per contract.

Operational lead times: for standard hosted EU-only routing: near-term (days). For a Private deployment with VPC + KMS and SOC evidence: engineering lead time ~3-6 weeks (depending on capacity and legal review).

Attachments to send to FinTech procurement: redlined DPA (I can produce a clean copy with SCC Annex), and a proposed SOW for Private deployment. I will draft the SCC language and a one-page runbook for Vivek to review.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Subject: Re: EU-only processing & VPC access for FinTech evaluation

Hi team / Lisa — adding the security plan and some operational commitments we can make.

Operational commitments we can deliver for a Private deployment:
- Private connectivity: support for AWS VPC peering, AWS PrivateLink, or customer-managed Transit Gateway.
- KMS: support for customer-managed AWS KMS keys; keys can be restricted to EU regions and Redwood will not export KMS material.
- Network controls: allowlist IP ranges, mutually authenticated TLS, and egress controls implemented at the VPC/NAT layer.
- Logging & evidence: deliverable includes CloudTrail logs, VPC flow logs, and a weekly audit extract for the first 3 months; thereafter monthly.
- Data deletion/certificates: on termination we will provide a deletion certificate and an export of data deletion events.

Notes on timing: 3-6 weeks to provision and validate depending on account requirements. Costs: Private deployment is covered under our Dedicated/Private pricing (we will include an SOW).

Lisa — if you can confirm: 1) whether logical isolation (single-tenant tenancy but managed by Redwood in EU) meets your compliance bar or 2) you need air-gapped / physical isolation, we will prepare the SOW accordingly.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
